interpretation_warning: The template field universal_overlap_blocker denotes complete coverage (no uncovered allowed cells), not whether a fixed-budget candidate exceeds the 70% gate. Do not interpret false as clearance. For the documented 36,800-dot budget, use fixed_budget_overlap_bound.blocks_this_budget.

fixed_budget_overlap_bound.scope: A 36,800-dot candidate whose dots lie in the stated allowed footprint. This is a pigeonhole lower bound, not a measured candidate-to-registry overlap or a claim for every budget.
